title: Scenario Presets
description: Support reusable, named policy scenarios so users start from a coherent position rather than blank sliders. Provides scenarios.yaml, a validated loader, a UI selector and human-readable summaries.
rationale: Presets make the tool approachable, demonstrate the breadth of policy space, and provide stable reference points for scoring and leaderboards.
success_criteria: All seven initial scenarios load, validate and run without error
Selecting a scenario populates every lever and assumption deterministically
An invalid or missing scenario file fails clearly in the UI
Each scenario has a one-paragraph summary visible to users
notes:
## Scope (in)
- scenarios.yaml describing each preset
- Schema-validating scenario loader
- Scenario selector in the UI
- Human-readable scenario summaries
- Scenario documentation
- Initial set: Baseline, Fairness Swap, Social Investment, Deficit Repair, Universal Basic Services, UBI Experiment, Austerity Trap

## Out of scope
- User-created/saved scenarios (EPIC-004)
- Scoring of scenarios (EPIC-003)
- Sharing scenarios publicly (EPIC-006)

## Dependencies
- EPIC-001 - presets are sets of inputs to the core engine

## Assumptions
- Preset values are illustrative, human-curated and clearly labelled
- YAML is acceptable for a small, human-edited set
- Each preset maps cleanly onto existing engine inputs

## Risks
- Preset values become stale as engine evolves -> validate against engine schema
- Presets misread as endorsements -> neutral framing + caveats
- Schema drift between YAML and code -> versioned schema + clear validation errors

## Future extensions
- Scenario inheritance (a preset extending another)
- Community-contributed presets (gated review)
- Scenario tags/themes feeding EPIC-007 filtering
